title: Tell verifiers to cite recorded fmt/clippy/test results, not rerun
summary: Add one short instruction to the verifier prompt: when the brief's "Checks Athena ran on this tree" section records fmt, clippy and test results for the candidate, cite them and don't rerun the full suite; run the check only if it's missing. Add a CHANGELOG entry citing the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts. The audience is verifiers (and the maintainer reading the diff).

defaults_applied.how: One focused prompt edit plus a changelog line.
Criteria check the prompt's instructions and run the athena-context tests.
Behavior criterion runs cargo test -p athena-context.
The changelog entry states the reason with the date and measured duration.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Scope follows the user's earlier correction: prompt text plus changelog only.
The producer runs only `cargo test -p athena-context` while editing and the full suite at most once at the end, because earlier attempts hit the 1800s deadline from repeated full runs.
The context verifier.md is the primary edit point; the cap-change prompt already says Athena ran the checks and is edited only if needed.
If the producer cannot finish, it stops early and reports its partial diff.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md says the fmt, clippy and test results under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' are recorded for this candidate: cite them, and do not rerun the full cargo test suite.
The prompt says a criterion like 'cargo test passes' is met by citing the recorded check, and new behavior is exercised only with targeted commands such as `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`.
The prompt keeps that a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass; the verifier may then run that one check.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes) as the reason.
The diff touches only prompt markdown and CHANGELOG.md: no Rust source, config, or watchdog/retry machinery.
Run `cargo test -p athena-context`; it passes, so the prompt edit did not break brief snapshot tests.

out_of_scope: Producer watchdog, checkpoint, or retry machinery
Changes to Rust source, athena.toml, or defaults.toml
Changes to how check results are recorded in briefs.rs
departures: Slightly higher acceptance because the user already approved this scope; cost lowered because the producer is told to avoid full-suite runs.
